learning_extracted: Decoupling the readout from survival works: guaranteed events -> the rebinding mechanism passes DV1 6/6 and DV2 6/6 (tracks truth 3-6x above shuffle; 8-14 step graded advantage vs frozen).

The teleport decoupled P1 overtakes but NOT P0 prototype-build: it is a pure position read that cannot stop starvation truncating P0 episodes; and MIN_REGION_VISITS_P0 is granularity-blind (K=4 floor applied to K=16).
P-B is one harness fix away from a counted PASS -- the recurrence is a test-bed operationalisation gap, not a mechanism ceiling.

cluster_pattern.shape: readiness-gate-unmet across both legs of the 733a portfolio, but via structurally different proximate causes (P-A: overtakes+binder starved by foraging concentration; P-B: P0 coverage starved by starvation-truncation + granularity-blind floor)
cluster_pattern.structural_property: Every readiness measure remains coupled to the agent's foraging survival/spatial distribution, and competent foraging concentrates coverage. Wherever the test-bed forcibly decouples a measure from foraging (P-B P1 teleport -> overtakes 62-808, DV1/DV2 6/6) it clears cleanly; wherever it stays survival-coupled (P-A overtakes, P-A binder prototypes, P-B P0 build) it fails. The fault is the incomplete decoupling of readiness from survival in the functional harness; the MECH-456 mechanism is refuted as the fault locus.
cluster_pattern.forces_planning_decision: Fix the test-bed (decouple P0 prototype-coverage from survival + granularity-scale the floor), refuse the P-A survival-onboarding axis, then one P-B re-run (V3-EXQ-733b). Do NOT demote or V4-park MECH-456; do NOT re-queue a survival letter.
